title: No OR gates after the De Morgan transformation
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose every gate has distinct arguments and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. Then the circuit obtained by the De Morgan transformation contains no OR gates.
hypotheses_covered: Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
